tools.name: check_certificate
tools.title: Check a TLS certificate
tools.description: Connects to a domain on port 443 and reports its TLS certificate: whether it is trusted and matches the name, the issuer, the expiry date and days left, the lifetime, the chain and the TLS version.

domain.description: A public domain name, like example.com. A URL also works: only its host name is used.

tools.name: check_domain_expiry
tools.title: Check a domain registration expiry
tools.description: Looks up when a domain registration expires, over RDAP at the registry for its TLD. Subdomains are looked up by their registered domain (www.example.co.uk becomes example.co.uk).

domain.description: A public domain name, like example.com. A URL also works: only its host name is used.
